summary: Propose Tab trap on #checkout-modal to cycle focus within the dialog and prevent escape to background while open.
rationale: Observed evidence shows Tab from #checkout-modal-continue escapes to #background-control while modal stays open. Handling Tab/Shift+Tab on the dialog and wrapping first-to-last/last-to-first keeps focus inside #checkout-modal without changing markup semantics, close behavior, or background content.

edits.originalText:
<div
                role="dialog"
                aria-modal="true"
                aria-labelledby="checkout-modal-title"
                data-testid="checkout-modal"
                id="checkout-modal"
                className="checkout-modal"
              >
edits.replacementText:
<div
                role="dialog"
                aria-modal="true"
                aria-labelledby="checkout-modal-title"
                data-testid="checkout-modal"
                id="checkout-modal"
                className="checkout-modal"
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
                  const container = e.currentTarget;
                  const focusable = Array.from(
                    container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
                      'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
                    )
                  ).filter((el) => !el.hasAttribute("disabled"));
                  if (focusable.length === 0) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    return;
                  }
                  const first = focusable[0];
                  const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
                  if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    last.focus();
                  } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    first.focus();
                  }
                }}
              >
edits.reason: Add Tab/Shift+Tab containment on the dialog element so focus cycles among Close, Email, and Continue instead of escaping to background controls.

risks: Initial focus placement and focus return on close are not changed by this edit; separate handling may still be needed for full dialog pattern.
Query selector list must stay in sync if new focusable types are added to dialog.
verificationPlan: Open #checkout-modal and Tab/Shift+Tab through all focusable elements, verifying focus stays inside #checkout-modal.
